title: The closed frame box {t ∈ span g : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r ∀ i} is compact
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P and r ∈ ℝ. Then the set {t ∈ span{g_1, …, g_k} : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r for all i} is compact.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (r : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ g → IsCompact {t : Euclid P | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}
